meta.method: manual source inspection + Phase 0.1 and Phase 1: live tested implementations (23/23 Phase 1 tests passing)
meta.trustNote: This file supersedes DEVELOPER_HANDOFF.md and README.md claims wherever they conflict. See PROJECT_BRAIN.md Section 26, 'Phase 0.1 Security Hardening', and 'Phase 1 - Authentication & Staff Identity'.

project.name: SportingSpy
project.type: single Vite+React SPA with a thin Express backend

architecture.serverRuntime: tsx (runs server.ts directly, dev and 'prod start' use identical command)

web.description: Public site + admin console, single SPA

server.description: Express server: JSON-file persistence, REST API, RBAC middleware (header-based, unverified), redirect engine, dynamic sitemap/robots, scheduled article publisher

database.seedBehaviorOnMissingFile: auto-created from seed data on first server start

Sport.cascadeOnDelete: blocked if events or articles reference it (orphan guard present)

SportEvent.cascadeOnDelete: blocked if editions or articles reference it (orphan guard present)

EventEdition.cascadeOnDelete: NOT GUARDED - deleting can orphan articles referencing editionYear
EventEdition.bug: missing orphan-article guard unlike Sport/Event deletes

uniqueConstraints: slug unique within (sportSlug, eventSlug, editionYear) scope
Article.contentFormat: plain string, entered via raw textarea; rendering path (ArticlePage.tsx) NOT VERIFIED for XSS safety
Article.scheduledPublishing: real, automated via 30s server interval + on-read trigger

Author.uniqueConstraints: slug NOT enforced on API create (gap)
Author.articleCountField: set to 0 on create, never incremented server-side

User.creationViaAdminUI: MOCK - local React state only, no server persistence, no POST /api/users route exists

fk: userId denormalized, not a live FK

MediaItem.uploadMechanism: URL text entry, not a real file upload

AuditLog.identitySource: same spoofable header-derived identity as RBAC

RedirectRule.serverEnforcement: real 301/302 via Express middleware with loop/chain detection (max 5 hops)

StaticPage.note: hardcoded JSX in src/pages/StaticPages.tsx, not database-backed

Permission.note: hardcoded role arrays inline in server.ts, not a data model

Settings.note: BRANDING config is a static TS file, not a database model or admin-editable

SeoMetadata.note: embedded on Sport/SportEvent/EventEdition/Article, not a standalone table

relationships.enforcementMechanism: string slug/ID matching in application code, no real foreign keys
relationships.hierarchy: Sport -> SportEvent -> EventEdition -> Article, plus Sport -> Article (general guides, no event)

admin.guardMechanism: server-env-configured development identity (Phase 0.1); client-supplied role headers no longer trusted

tabs.crud: role-change real, user creation MOCK (not persisted)
create/update/delete metadata only, no real upload

desktopZones: brand wordmark (text only, from BRANDING config)
navigation.mobileMenuBug: shows sports.slice(0,8) without isVisible filter, inconsistent with desktop

authRbac.authenticationType: real email+password login with server-side sessions (Phase 1)
authRbac.productionAuthImplemented: partial - real login/sessions exist; no password reset, MFA, email verification, or CSRF token yet
authRbac.passwordHashing: Node crypto.scrypt, per-user random salt, timing-safe verification (server/password.ts)
authRbac.sessionType: opaque random token cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production) resolved against a `sessions` collection in data/db.json - no signing secret needed since the cookie carries no data
authRbac.identitySource: server/auth.ts: session cookie -> data/db.json sessions -> users. DEV_LOGIN_BYPASS (disabled by default, env-gated) is the only non-session path and never overrides a real session.
authRbac.roleSwitchingIsUiPreviewOnly: REMOVED in Phase 1 - real login/logout UI replaces the fake role switcher entirely
authRbac.serverEnforcement: requireAuth()/requireRole() in server/auth.ts derive AuthContext from the resolved session's user record; x-user-id/x-user-role are never read for authorization
authRbac.productionStartupGuard: AUTH_MODE=production now boots successfully (real auth exists); refused only if DEV_LOGIN_BYPASS=true is also set
authRbac.severityNoteHistorical: FIXED IN PHASE 0.1: any HTTP client could previously set x-user-role: Admin and pass all permission checks. FIXED IN PHASE 1: the Phase 0.1 placeholder identity (env-var configured, not real login) is replaced by real per-user authentication.
authRbac.lastActiveAdminProtection: role change, deactivation, and deletion of the sole active Admin are all blocked with 400 (isLastActiveAdmin() in server.ts)

roles.Admin: full access to all mutation endpoints
roles.Editor: articles/events/editions create+update, comments moderate+delete, authors create+update, media create+update; no deletes on sports/events/editions
roles.Author: articles create + update own only, enforced via real Author.userId<->User.id linkage (Phase 1 fix; hardcoded 'auth-alistair' bypass removed in Phase 0.1, underlying ID-namespace bug fixed in Phase 1)
roles.Reader: comments create only (auto-pending); requires a real authenticated session since there is no public visitor account system yet (staff-only auth, documented distinction in server.ts)

comments.requiresRealSession: Phase 1: comment posting requires a real authenticated staff session; no public visitor accounts exist yet

sitemapRobots.duplicateSourceRisk: static public/ files vs dynamic server.ts routes may collide depending on static-serving precedence in production, not verified

redirects.nginxConfigExport: text generator only, not wired to deployment automation
redirects.destinationSchemeValidation: added Phase 0.1: sourceUrl must be a relative site path, targetUrl must be http(s) or relative - javascript:/data: schemes rejected

security.authenticationNote: Phase 1: real email+password login with server-side sessions. Not a complete production auth system - no password reset, MFA, or email verification yet.
security.authorization: session-derived AuthContext (server/auth.ts); client-supplied role headers no longer trusted or read (Phase 0.1), placeholder dev identity replaced by real per-user sessions (Phase 1)
security.inputValidation: centralized in server/validation.ts: presence, length caps, slug format, safe-URL-scheme checks (Phase 0.1) plus email format and password strength (Phase 1), applied to article/sport/event/edition/author/comment/media/ad/redirect/user mutation endpoints
security.xssRiskFinding: ArticlePage/comments/author bios render as plain React JSX text (auto-escaped, safe). The only dangerouslySetInnerHTML sites (SeoHead.tsx, Breadcrumbs.tsx JSON-LD) had a real script-tag-breakout gap, fixed by escaping '<' to \u003c before injection.
security.xssFixVerified: confirmed via standalone test: breakout payload neutralized and JSON round-trips losslessly
security.csrfProtection: partial - SameSite=Lax cookie only, no CSRF token (Phase 2 follow-up)
security.rateLimiting: login endpoint only (server/rateLimit.ts): 8 attempts per (IP,email) per 15 min, in-memory, resets on restart, does not scale across instances (Phase 2 follow-up)
security.passwordHandling: Node crypto.scrypt with per-user random salt, timing-safe comparison, timing-camouflage on unknown-email login attempts (server/password.ts)
security.sessionManagement: opaque random session id in HttpOnly cookie, resolved against data/db.json sessions collection; 7-day expiry; deactivation/deletion of a user immediately invalidates their sessions
security.draftPreviewQueryBypassRemoved: the old ?preview=true query param that let any anonymous client view unpublished articles was removed in Phase 0.1; preview visibility is now decided solely by AuthContext.role
security.productionAuthStartupGuard: AUTH_MODE=production now boots successfully (Phase 1: real auth exists); refused only if DEV_LOGIN_BYPASS=true is also set
security.eventEditionOrphanGuard: added Phase 1: DELETE /api/editions/:id blocked with 400 if dependent articles exist, mirroring the existing Sport/Event guards

variables.name: DEV_LOGIN_BYPASS
variables.note: disabled by default; replaces Phase 0.1's DEV_USER_ROLE/DEV_AUTH_TOKEN which are no longer read

geminiAi.evidence: zero grep matches for genai/GEMINI in src/

known_gaps: RESOLVED (Phase 0.1 + 1): No real authentication/session system - RBAC was header-spoofable (Phase 0.1 fix), then replaced entirely with real email+password login + server-side sessions (Phase 1). Still not a complete production auth system - no password reset/MFA/email verification/CSRF token.
RESOLVED (Phase 1): Admin user creation via UI is now server-persisted (POST /api/users) with hashed passwords
RESOLVED (Phase 1): EventEdition delete now has an orphan-article guard, mirroring Sport/Event
Mobile nav sports list ignores isVisible filter
RESOLVED (Phase 0.1): Article.content renders as plain JSX text (safe); JSON-LD script-breakout XSS in SeoHead.tsx/Breadcrumbs.tsx was found and fixed
Search is client-side substring filter only, no server search, no pagination
No tests, no CI, no lint beyond tsc --noEmit

RESOLVED (Phase 0.1 + 1): Hardcoded 'auth-alistair' article-ownership bypass removed (Phase 0.1); the underlying Author/User ID-namespace mismatch that necessitated it was fixed via a real Author.userId<->User.id link (Phase 1)
BRANDING.colors not actually wired through a live theme token system
RESOLVED (Phase 1, partial): login rate limiting now exists; still in-memory only, doesn't scale across instances (Phase 2 follow-up); no rate limiting on other endpoints
RESOLVED (Phase 1): Comments now require a REAL authenticated staff session (not a dev credential); no public visitor account system exists yet (documented STAFF vs PUBLIC distinction)
No CSRF token (SameSite=Lax only) - tracked for Phase 2
A new Author-role staff account with no linked Author profile gets a raw-userId byline until an Admin creates a matching Author profile
